title: Targeted Ads and/as Racial Discrimination: Exploring Trends in New York City Ads for College Scholarships
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on racial discrimination in targeted advertising.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its analysis is entirely focused on racial discrimination.
